source: VS Code's own docs at cc3fec88: .github/instructions/writing-tests.instructions.md, .github/skills/unit-tests/SKILL.md, .github/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md, .github/skills/smoke-tests/SKILL.md, test/README.md, test/unit/README.md, test/smoke/README.md, test/automation/README.md, test/sanity/README.md

points.text: unit tests are `*.test.ts` files in `test/` folders beside the code they test (`src/vs/**/test/`), written with Mocha (`suite`/`test`) and `assert`, with `sinon` for mocks
points.check: Doc: .github/instructions/writing-tests.instructions.md L12-14 (the Test Types table: unit tests, `.test.ts`, `src/vs/**/test/`) and L28 ('Tests use Mocha's BDD interface (`suite`/`test`) with the `assert` module and `sinon` for mocks'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): 2,408 tracked src/**/*.test.ts files, none outside a test/ folder (git ls-files 'src/*.test.ts' | grep -v '/test/' is empty); package.json L16 runs mocha with --ui=tdd (suite/test is Mocha's TDD interface, which the doc calls BDD); src/vs/base/test/common/async.test.ts L7 imports sinon.
points.note: Doc: .github/instructions/writing-tests.instructions.md L12-14 (unit tests, `.test.ts`, `src/vs/**/test/`) and L28 (suite/test with `assert` and `sinon`). Code: all 2,408 tracked src/**/*.test.ts files are under src/vs/ and inside a test/ folder (git ls-files 'src/*.test.ts' | grep -v '/test/' is empty); 2,392 import 'assert' and 188 import 'sinon' (e.g. src/vs/base/test/common/async.test.ts L6-7); the runners set Mocha's TDD UI (test/unit/electron/renderer.js L451, test/unit/browser/renderer.html L78, package.json L16 --ui=tdd), which is the suite/test interface the doc miscalls BDD; the point avoids that word. The test/ folders sit per area and layer (src/vs/base/test/common mirrors src/vs/base/common), which is what 'beside' means here. In scope.

points.text: `scripts/test.sh` (`scripts/test.bat` on Windows) runs the unit tests with Mocha inside an Electron renderer, which has both the DOM and Node.js APIs, the closest to the environment VS Code ships in; options such as `--run`, `--grep` and `--runGlob` pick the tests
points.check: Doc: test/unit/README.md L3-10 ('All unit tests are run inside a Electron renderer environment which access to DOM and Nodejs api. This is the closest to the environment in which VS Code itself ships'); .github/skills/unit-tests/SKILL.md L18-25 (the scripts 'download Electron if needed and launch the Mocha test runner') and L29-83 (--run, --grep, --runGlob); writing-tests.instructions.md L20-22. Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): scripts/test.sh L27-48 fetches Electron and launches it on test/unit/electron/index.js; scripts/test.bat.
points.note: Doc: test/unit/README.md L5-10 (Electron renderer 'which access to DOM and Nodejs api. This is the closest to the environment in which VS Code itself ships'; --run/--glob); .github/skills/unit-tests/SKILL.md L20-25 and L47-83 (--run, --grep, --runGlob). Code: scripts/test.sh L27-47 and scripts/test.bat L15-23 fetch Electron and launch it on test/unit/electron/index.js; index.js L404-411 opens a BrowserWindow with nodeIntegration: true and L467-469 loads renderer.html; renderer.js L450-466 sets up and runs Mocha; index.js L66-70 and L91 declare grep/run/runGlob. In scope.

points.text: unit tests from the `common` and `browser` layers also run in real browsers (Chromium and WebKit, through Playwright, with `npm run test-browser`), and unit tests can run under plain Node.js too (`npm run test-node`)
points.check: Doc: test/unit/README.md L15-26 ('Unit tests from layers `common` and `browser` are run inside `chromium`, `webkit`, and (soon'ish) `firefox` (using playwright)') and L28-36 (the Node.js runner, npm run test-node); writing-tests.instructions.md L14 ('Browser, Electron, or Node.js (depends on layer)'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): package.json L14 test-browser ('npx playwright install && node test/unit/browser/index.js') and L16 test-node; test/unit/browser/index.js L18 requires @playwright/test and L245 launches the browser; test/unit/node/.
points.note: Doc: test/unit/README.md L15-26 (layers `common` and `browser` in chromium and webkit via playwright, `npm run test-browser`) and L28-36 (`npm run test-node`). Code: package.json L14 and L16; test/unit/browser/index.js L18 (@playwright/test), L118 (excludes node/electron-* tests, leaving common and browser), L245 (playwright[browserType].launch); test/unit/node/index.js L64 excludes browser/electron-* tests. The browser runner's default list also includes firefox (index.js L46), which the point omits; immaterial. In scope.

points.text: integration tests are `*.integrationTest.ts` files under `src/` that exercise real external APIs; `scripts/test.sh` doesn't run them, `scripts/test-integration.sh` (`.bat` on Windows) does, in Electron with the same Mocha runner
points.check: Doc: writing-tests.instructions.md L15 (integration tests, `.integrationTest.ts`, `src/vs/**/test/`, 'Real external APIs') and L23; .github/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md L8-10 ('files ending in `.integrationTest.ts` under `src/`. These run in Electron via the same Mocha runner as unit tests') and L127-132; .github/skills/unit-tests/SKILL.md L99-101 ('not run by `scripts/test.sh`'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): 61 tracked src/**/*.integrationTest.ts files; scripts/test-integration.sh L188 runs ./scripts/test.sh with --runGlob **/*.integrationTest.js.
points.note: Doc: writing-tests.instructions.md L15 (`.integrationTest.ts`, 'Real external APIs', in the table's 'Runs in' column) and L23; .github/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md L10 ('run in Electron via the same Mocha runner as unit tests'); unit-tests/SKILL.md L101 ('not run by scripts/test.sh'). Code: 61 tracked src/**/*.integrationTest.ts files, all under src/vs/**/test/ (real file system, processes, sqlite storage, the agent host protocol); test/unit/electron/renderer.js L90 (test.sh's default glob is **/test/**/*.test.js, so they're skipped); scripts/test-integration.sh L188 runs ./scripts/test.sh --runGlob '**/*.integrationTest.js'; scripts/test-integration.bat exists. In scope.

points.text: extension host tests (the extension API tests, and tests of built-in extensions such as Git, TypeScript and Emmet) live with the extensions under `extensions/`; `scripts/test-integration.sh` runs them too, launching a full VS Code with `--extensionDevelopmentPath`, and `--suite` picks which ones
points.check: Doc: .github/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md L11 ('Extension host tests - tests embedded in built-in extensions under `extensions/` (API tests, Git tests, TypeScript tests, etc.). These launch a full VS Code instance with `--extensionDevelopmentPath`'), L18 and L60-64 (--suite and the suite names); writing-tests.instructions.md L16 (extension tests, `extensions/*/`, 'Extension host'); test/README.md L8 ('integration: our suite of API tests'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): scripts/test-integration.sh L224 and L232 (extensions/vscode-api-tests with --extensionDevelopmentPath and --extensionTestsPath), L256 (typescript-language-features), L272 (emmet), L280 (git).
points.note: Doc: integration-tests/SKILL.md L11 (extension host tests under `extensions/`, 'API tests, Git tests, TypeScript tests', full VS Code with `--extensionDevelopmentPath`), L18 (run after the node.js tests), L60-64 (--suite and its names); writing-tests.instructions.md L16. Code: scripts/test-integration.sh L220-232 (extensions/vscode-api-tests), L252-256 (typescript-language-features), L268-272 (emmet), L276-280 (git), all with --extensionDevelopmentPath; extensions/vscode-api-tests/src/{singlefolder,workspace}-tests, extensions/git/src/test, extensions/emmet/src/test exist. The css/html/json suites run without a workbench (SKILL L66); immaterial. In scope.

points.text: smoke tests in `test/smoke/` drive a whole VS Code (Electron, web or remote) through end-to-end UI flows with Playwright, through the automation driver in `test/automation`; `npm run smoketest` compiles and runs them
points.check: Doc: .github/skills/smoke-tests/SKILL.md L8 ('Smoke tests live in `test/smoke/` and drive a full VS Code instance (Electron, web, or remote) through end-to-end user flows'), L12-13 (npm run smoketest compiles, then runs) and L19-26 (--web, --remote, --tracing for Playwright traces); test/README.md L9 ('smoke: our suite of automated UI tests'); test/smoke/README.md L7-26 and L59-61 (playwright); test/automation/README.md L3 (the automation driver 'used by the `smoke` tests'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): package.json L65-66 (smoketest, smoketest-no-compile); test/automation/src/playwrightDriver.ts, playwrightElectron.ts, playwrightBrowser.ts.
points.note: Doc: .github/skills/smoke-tests/SKILL.md L8 (test/smoke/, full VS Code, Electron, web or remote, end-to-end flows), L12 (`npm run smoketest` compiles then runs); test/smoke/README.md L7-26 and L59-61; test/automation/README.md L3 (the automation driver 'used by the `smoke` tests'). Code: package.json L65 (compile test/smoke, which compiles ../automation per test/smoke/package.json L7, then node test/index.js); test/smoke/src/main.ts L14 imports '../../automation'; test/automation/src/playwrightElectron.ts L49 (playwright _electron.launch) and playwrightBrowser.ts L19-25. In scope.

points.text: the top-level `test/` folder holds the test runners and the suites that test the product as a whole: `unit` (the runners for the unit tests in `src/`), `integration` (the API tests), `smoke` and `sanity` (release sanity tests of published builds)
points.check: Doc: test/README.md L5-10 ('This folder contains the various test runners for VS Code': unit, integration, smoke, sanity, each with its README); test/sanity/README.md L5-7 ('Automated end-to-end release sanity tests for published VS Code builds'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): test/ holds automation, componentFixtures, integration, mcp, monaco, sanity, scenario, smoke and unit; test/unit/electron, test/unit/browser and test/unit/node are the unit-test runners.
points.note: Doc: test/README.md L5-10 ('This folder contains the various test runners for VS Code': unit, integration 'our suite of API tests', smoke, sanity); test/sanity/README.md L5 ('release sanity tests for published VS Code builds'). Code: test/ holds automation, componentFixtures, integration, mcp, monaco, sanity, scenario, smoke, unit; test/unit/{electron,browser,node} are the unit runners. Caveat, immaterial: test/integration holds the runners for the API tests (browser/src/index.ts, electron/testrunner.js) and the agent host e2e runner (agentHost/runner.ts); the API test code itself is in extensions/vscode-api-tests (as BP6.5 says). In scope.

points.text: tests run against the compiled JavaScript output (`out/`), not the TypeScript sources, so the code has to be compiled (or the watch build running) before running them
points.check: Doc: .github/skills/unit-tests/SKILL.md L103-105 ('Tests run against compiled JavaScript output ... Test failures caused by stale output are a common pitfall') and L83 (a glob runs 'against compiled `.js` files in the output directory'); .github/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md L123-125; test/unit/README.md L11 ('use `npm run watch` to automatically compile changes'). Code (author's pointers, for the re-checker): test/unit/electron/renderer.js L114-115 (outdir 'out', or 'out-build' with --build).
